Mating-pad refs (those starting with 'P_') anchor at (0,0) automatically and are listed here only when they need explicit rotation or face. U_HACC.reason: H3LIS331 ±400g high-G accel: deliberately offset 1.0/1.0 mm (= 1.41 mm radius) from the spin axis so its centripetal term a = ω²r is a usable, non-zero spin-rate readout (≈20 g at 60 Hz, ≈228 g at 200 Hz) — the only roll/ω sensor that survives both spin rates, since the ISM330 gyro saturates (>4000 dps) and the IIS2MDC mag is sub-Nyquist at 200 Hz. The 1.41 mm radius is small enough to stay inside ±400 g even at 200 Hz worst case and to dominate the unspecified intrinsic MEMS proof-mass offset (DS9012 does not give it), yet keeps the axial setback reading clean (centripetal lands on X/Y; <5% cross-axis bleed is negligible vs the launch g). Characterise r_eff empirically (spin at known ω → r_eff=√(a/ω²)). Stays on activation_interface's TOP face, opposite the bottom-face cell + contacts (P_CELL_CONTACTS).

U_PMIC.reason: Anchor at power_board centre so the four buck inductors + decoupling cluster spread radially around the QFN and every flex-launch quadrant is reachable with similarly short rails.

P_PIEZO.reason: SMD10T04R111 launch piezo: pinned dead-centre on the projectile spin axis, on fin_ble_board's TOP face (2026-07-31 stack reorder — the disc + comparator column swapped off the saturated aft_end top; fin_ble is the battery-compartment ceiling now). TOP (nose-facing) is the hard mechanical rule: setback loads the ceramic in COMPRESSION against rigid FR4 (~1-2 MPa vs >500 MPa strength); an aft-facing mount would put its ~114 N @ 46.7 kG on the In52 joints in tension (~UTS) or bend it over potting voids — never move the disc to an aft-facing face. ⚠ open assembly item: PZT depoles >~160 C, so the final In52/Sn48 118 C attach step needs the fin_ble↔wakeup gap still open (attach, close the fold, pot) — verify the fold/pot sequence. _mark_battery_chip_clearance's P_PIEZO branch is inert while the disc rides a non-bracket face.
